libs.note: BH-5268. The stored conflict hotspots (GET /api/conflict-hotspots, BH-5267) that the plan-time overlap gate adds to a plan's claim when the plan names them anywhere outside its Sibling claims section. Read by bin/plan-overlap.sh (both sides of the comparison) and the hotspot claim region of bin/lib/rb/plan.sh (the published claim). A per-project row lib.plan-overlap-hotspots.<project>.<env> wins over the global one.

knobs.note: How many hotspot rows (highest conflicts first) are read per project. 0 = hotspots off, no request. Code fallback 50 in ph_conf. A value outside 0..500 or not an integer turns hotspots off for that run with one PLAN_HOTSPOTS_BADKNOB stderr line; it is never clamped.

The minimum stored conflicts count for a row to count as a hotspot. Code fallback 2 in ph_conf: a file that conflicted once is noise. A value outside 1..1000 or not an integer turns hotspots off for that run with one PLAN_HOTSPOTS_BADKNOB stderr line; it is never clamped.
